color.note: Dark is the default and the fully designed theme; light is a secondary override set. High contrast is dark with every text role at 7:1 or more and every border and mark at 3:1 or more. A theme is chosen with data-theme or data-ds-theme (data-ds-theme wins when both are set). With no theme chosen, prefers-contrast: more selects high contrast, then prefers-color-scheme: light selects light, and dark is the default. A theme that extends another inherits its values and also replaces it under its media query, so an explicit dark choice still becomes high contrast when the viewer asks for more contrast. Paper and night are reading modes a viewer chooses (no media query): paper a warm, softer light page, night a warm, softer dark one. The rail and bar roles (`ds-rail-*`, `ds-bar-*`) are the navigation chrome's own grounds, text, borders and accent; by default they are the page's, and a brand can give the chrome its own color. The five ramps are theme-independent.

tokens.name: ds-tabbar-h
tokens.usage: The phone tab bar's height. The bottom safe-area inset is added on top of it, not included.

tokens.name: ds-chrome-bottom
tokens.usage: Space fixed chrome takes at the bottom: 0 on desktop, the tab bar plus safe area under 768px. Pages pad by it; toasts lift above it.

breakpoint.note: The only viewport widths in the system. Components use container queries; the shell uses these.

tokens.name: ds-bp-compact
tokens.usage: Below this a justified image row targets 70% of its usual height, so two or three pictures still share a row.

tokens.name: ds-bp-phone
tokens.usage: The phone boundary: the nav rail becomes a tab bar, Popover becomes Sheet, Field row layout stacks, page inset drops to 16px. The single most important width in the system.

tokens.name: ds-bp-wide
tokens.usage: Where a work view has room for a side-by-side pane instead of stacking its zones.

tokens.name: ds-bp-rail
tokens.usage: At or above this the nav rail starts expanded when the viewer has expressed no preference; below it starts collapsed.

tokens.name: ds-dur-fast
tokens.usage: Hover, press, chip toggle. Zeroed under `prefers-reduced-motion`.

tokens.name: ds-dur-base
tokens.usage: Popover, toast in, rail expand, thumbnail scale. Zeroed under `prefers-reduced-motion`.

tokens.name: ds-dur-slow
tokens.usage: Sheet rise, overlay fade. Zeroed under `prefers-reduced-motion`.

tokens.name: ds-ease-out
tokens.usage: The default: everything that enters or responds. Nothing bounces.

tokens.name: ds-ease-in-out
tokens.usage: A symmetric move, such as the rail's width change.

zIndex.note: The stacking order. Assign layers from these, never a literal z-index. Modal Dialog and Sheet use the native top layer and need none.

tokens.name: ds-z-raised
tokens.usage: A cell or row lifted over its neighbors, such as a sticky table header inside its scroller.

tokens.name: ds-z-sticky
tokens.usage: Sticky PageHeader, ActionBar and the phone TabBar.

tokens.name: ds-z-topbar
tokens.usage: TopBar, one step above sticky page chrome so its menus are never covered.
